question: 加购的商品最后有多少比例被买了？
trap: 按商品（用户×商品）算 ≈ 6%，按用户算 ≈ 72%
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(has_buy) / COUNT(*), 4) FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, MAX(behavior_type = 'cart') AS has_cart, MAX(behavior_type = 'buy') AS has_buy FROM ub GROUP BY user_id, item_id) t WHERE has_cart = 1

question: 收藏过的商品有多少比例被买了？
trap: 按商品算，不是按用户算
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(has_buy) / COUNT(*), 4) FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, MAX(behavior_type = 'fav') AS has_fav, MAX(behavior_type = 'buy') AS has_buy FROM ub GROUP BY user_id, item_id) t WHERE has_fav = 1

question: 用户转化率是多少？
trap: 分母是全部用户（UV），不是浏览过的用户；分子是购买用户数，不是购买次数
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 4) FROM ub

question: 复购用户占比是多少？
trap: 分母是购买用户，不是全部用户
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(n >= 2) / COUNT(*), 4) FROM (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' GROUP BY user_id) t

question: 用户人均购买次数是多少？
trap: 知识文件没有定义！分析报告按购买用户算（2.98），按全部用户算是 2.04
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(n), 2) FROM (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' GROUP BY user_id) t

question: 浏览到购买的转化率是多少？
trap: 行为次数口径 buy/pv，不是购买用户/浏览用户

question: 每天的购买转化率分别是多少？
trap: 按天比较用行为次数口径 buy/pv，不是购买用户/DAU
ref_sql: SELECT d, ROUND(SUM(behavior_type = 'buy') / SUM(behavior_type = 'pv'), 4) FROM ub GROUP BY d

question: 11月27日活跃用户的 3 日留存率是多少？
trap: 第 3 天当天（11-30）活跃，不是 3 天内任意一天活跃
ref_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-27'), b AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-30') SELECT ROUND(COUNT(b.user_id) / COUNT(*), 4) FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.user_id = b.user_id

question: 11月30日的次日留存率是多少？
trap: 活跃日口径（11-30 活跃 → 12-01 活跃），不是新用户留存
ref_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-30'), b AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-12-01') SELECT ROUND(COUNT(b.user_id) / COUNT(*), 4) FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.user_id = b.user_id

question: 从加购到购买平均要隔多少小时？
trap: 同一用户×商品，首次加购 → 首次购买，只算购买晚于加购的
ref_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG((t_buy - t_cart) / 3600), 2) FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, MIN(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'cart' THEN ts END) AS t_cart, MIN(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN ts END) AS t_buy FROM ub GROUP BY user_id, item_id) t WHERE t_buy > t_cart
